pages.text: Amphibia is about raising useful frog lines. A frog is not just a pet; it can be breeding stock, $(l:zen_amphibia:resources/frog_slime)slime producer$(/l), color source, and eventually a Create logistics partner.
The basic loop is simple: feed frogs, breed frogs, inspect offspring, keep the useful lines, and improve the habitat. Start with $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/dna_basics)DNA Basics$(/l).
